tasks.instruction: Return the bucket number of value p0 for buckets of width p1 (p0 divided by p1, rounded down). When the width p1 is 0, return 0 instead.
tasks.note: Zero divisor in div yields all ones; the edit must map it to 0.

tasks.instruction: Return the 4-bit field held in bits 4 to 7 of p0 (bit 0 is the lowest), as a number from 0 to 15.
tasks.note: Mask must be 15; start keeps only 3 bits.

tasks.instruction: Return true when p0 is an exact multiple of p1 (p0 leaves no remainder when divided by p1). With p1 equal to 0, remainder of p0 is p0 itself, so only p0 = 0 counts.
tasks.note: rem with zero divisor gives the dividend.

tasks.instruction: Return a copy of the array p0 with the element at position p1 (taken modulo 4) replaced by the value p2.
The function should return the product of all four elements of the array p0 (wrapping modulo 2^32); currently it misses one element.
tasks.note: Fold count must cover all four elements; init must be 1.

tasks.instruction: Return true when p0 yes-votes out of p1 total votes form a strict majority, that is twice p0 is greater than p1. A tie is not a majority.
tasks.note: Inputs kept small so doubling does not wrap.

tasks.instruction: Pack the low byte of p0 into bits 8 to 15 and the low byte of p1 into bits 0 to 7; all other bits of the result must be 0. Mask both inputs to their low 8 bits.

Return a record (page, starts): page is item p0's page number for pages of p1 items (p0 divided by p1), and starts is true when item p0 is the first item on its page (p0 leaves remainder 0 when divided by p1).
tasks.note: Zero page size: div gives all ones, rem gives p0.

tasks.instruction: Return true only when both bit 0 (value 1) and bit 2 (value 4) of p0 are set.

The function should add one to the counter at position p1 and one to the counter at position p2 of array p0 (positions modulo 4; if they are the same position it gets two). Currently it counts the wrong positions.
tasks.note: Second bump must use the first's result and index p2.

tasks.instruction: Return p0 as a whole-number percentage of p1: p0 times 100 (wrapping modulo 2^32), divided by p1 and rounded down; a zero p1 gives the division's all-ones result.
The function should return the average of the four elements of p0, rounded down (the wrapped sum shifted right by 2 bits). Currently the divide step is wrong.
Return whichever of the elements at positions p1 and p2 of array p0 is larger (positions modulo 4); if they are equal return that value.
Return true when every element of array p0 is strictly less than p1 (currently it returns true when any element is). Fix both the per-element combination and the starting value.

Return (p0 - p1) modulo p2 as true modular arithmetic: reduce p0 and p1 modulo p2 first, add p2 to the reduced p0, subtract the reduced p1 and reduce modulo p2 again (all wrapping). When p2 is 0 this gives the wrapped p0 - p1.
tasks.note: Start fails because 2^32 is not a multiple of p2.

tasks.instruction: A header word p0 is valid when its version (the top four bits, read by the helper) is exactly 3 and its low byte is not 0. The function currently accepts any version of 3 or more; make it require exactly 3.
